request_text:
To Whom It May Concern: 

Please see the attached Public Records Act request regarding the proposed Harmony Grove Village South Project. Thank you.

Sincerely, 

Isabella Coye

Requestor updated request Friday 09/26/2025 at 10:32 am

I am reaching out regarding a Public Records Act ("PRA") request submitted to the County on September 4, 2025. The request number is 25-4697. The County has stated that it is still reviewing responsive records and will provide an update by September 30, 2025. 

While the County continues to review responsive records, I respectfully request immediate production of a discrete category of responsive records: 

    • All internal agency correspondence since October 21, 2024, in relation to the Harmony Grove Village South Project (the "Project"), including correspondence to or from agency's consulting firms (i.e., Dudek, Helix, etc.), but not including correspondence to or from the Project manager.

I request that these documents be produced by September 30, 2025, and that the remaining records requested in PRA #25-4697 be produced in batches thereafter. 

I further request that you confirm receipt of this email by the end of the day today. Thank you. 

Sincerely, 

Isabella Coye
